## Type

- [ ] fix — bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] Added/updated tests for this change
- [ ] Follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) in the commit messages
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour/config changed
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames, or private infrastructure details in the diff
- [ ] If it affects polling or a virtual meter: it **fails safe** and is opt-in for existing setups
